title: Tunisian Spiced Pilaf
description: A flavorful and aromatic North African-inspired pilaf dish, perfect for a weeknight meal. The combination of spices, couscous, and vegetables creates a delightful taste experience.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add diced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add sliced carrots and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add cumin, coriander, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add couscous and 2 cups of water to the saucepan. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 10-12 minutes or until the water is absorbed.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
